mapper.insert: INSERT INTO envio ( numero_guia, id_destinatario, id_cliente, id_sucursal, id_conductor, id_estatus_actual, costo_total, id_creador ) VALUES ( #{numeroGuia}, #{idDestinatario}, #{idCliente}, #{idSucursal}, #{idConductor}, #{idEstatusActual}, #{costoTotal}, #{idCreadoPor} )
mapper.update: UPDATE envio SET id_destinatario = #{idDestinatario}, id_cliente = #{idCliente}, id_sucursal = #{idSucursal}, id_conductor = #{idConductor}, id_estatus_actual = #{idEstatusActual} WHERE id_envio = #{idEnvio};

SELECT e.id_envio AS idEnvio, e.numero_guia AS numeroGuia,
e.id_destinatario AS idDestinatario, d.nombre AS nombreDestinatario, d.apellido_paterno AS apellidoPaternoDestinatario,
e.id_cliente AS idCliente, c.nombre AS nombreCliente, c.apellido_paterno AS apellidoPaternoCliente,
e.id_sucursal AS idSucursal, s.codigo AS codigoSucursal,
e.id_conductor AS idConductor, cond.numero_personal AS numeroPersonalConductor,
e.id_estatus_actual AS idEstatusActual, ee.nombre AS estatusActual,
e.costo_total AS costoTotal,
e.id_creador AS idCreadoPor, crea.numero_personal AS numeroPersonalColaborador FROM envio e JOIN destinatario d ON e.id_destinatario = d.id_destinatario JOIN cliente c ON e.id_cliente = c.id_cliente JOIN sucursal s ON e.id_sucursal = s.id_sucursal LEFT JOIN colaborador cond ON e.id_conductor = cond.id_colaborador JOIN colaborador crea ON e.id_creador = crea.id_colaborador JOIN estatus_envio ee ON e.id_estatus_actual = ee.id_estatus WHERE e.numero_guia = #{numeroGuia};
